definitions.gloss: employment type; form of employment contract
definitions.explanation: the classification of how a worker is employed, such as full-time, part-time, contract, or temporary

examples.japanese: {雇用形態|こようけいたい}を{確認|かくにん}する。
{雇用形態|こようけいたい}によって{給与|きゅうよ}が{違|ちが}う。
examples.english: Salary differs depending on employment type.

examples.japanese: この{求人|きゅうじん}の{雇用形態|こようけいたい}は{正社員|せいしゃいん}です。
examples.english: The employment type for this job posting is full-time employee.

notes:
TYPES OF {雇用形態|こようけいたい}:
- {正社員|せいしゃいん} - permanent full-time employee
- {契約社員|けいやくしゃいん} - contract employee
- {派遣社員|はけんしゃいん} - temporary staff (dispatched worker)
- パート - part-time worker
- アルバイト - part-time worker (often students)
- {嘱託|しょくたく} - commissioned employee
- {業務委託|ぎょうむいたく} - contractor

DIFFERENCES:
- {正規雇用|せいきこよう} - regular employment
- {非正規雇用|ひせいきこよう} - non-regular employment

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雇用形態|こようけいたい}を{変更|へんこう}する - change employment type
- {雇用形態|こようけいたい}に{関|かか}わらず - regardless of employment type
